title: Mrs. Metoyer's own background and music in her family
summary: Her age, maiden name Fernandez, French opera, and a loving but non-playing family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was wondering if you would mind Mrs. Matoye telling us something a little bit about yourself. If you don't mind even telling your age, I mean.
Oh, my age. I was 77 on the 26th day of February.
And what was your maiden name?
There's one musician I know from that family. Was it a musical family that you came from too? Well, no. Anyone in your family? No. Your father or brothers or anyone?
No. They liked music, but none of them was musical. Yes.
Had you heard much music when you were young before you met Mr. Matoye?
Well, yes, we used to go to the French opera, you know. It's about all the place they had at the time, you know. I like music very much, but I don't know anything about it.
I just wondered if you might have learned some instruments yourself. You never did. Did you sing? Yes. You told me I think Sunday that you could sing.

Very nice voice. Well, I used to sing for myself, you know. I enjoyed it. Sure. But we are a musical family. I don't have to play it, but we do love music. Yes. There's any kind, like I told you before, there's any kind of music that you can find. It's in our collection. We have all the songs. And all the boys sings. Yeah.
That's wonderful that you all have that interest in you.
